anomalies.observed: On the FCC Peripherals sheet, PCA9685 U13 has A0 tied to +3.3 and A1-A5 tied to GND, and the sheet note explicitly says 'I2C address: 0x41'.
anomalies.expected: The design specification component table states the PWM/servo driver PCA9685PW should have I2C addr 0x40, which corresponds to all address pins strapped low.

evidence.quote: FCC Peripherals sheet: U13 PCA9685PW, pin A0 to +3.3, pins A1-A5 to GND, note 'I2C address: 0x41'
PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40

anomalies.impact: The PWM driver is addressed at 0x41 instead of the specified 0x40. If the firmware expects the specified address, it will not communicate with the servo/PWM driver, changing the board's behavior from the intended design.

parsed.summary: The schematic shows the PCA9685 PWM driver strapped to I2C address 0x41, whereas the specification states the intended address is 0x40; this address-strapping deviation is the main anomaly.
